limitations: Infrastructure admission is explicitly unsupported and rejected; existing production registry validation is unchanged.
Declared semantic relationships are RDF-queryable; implementation and structured profile fields remain separate versioned bindings.
The trusted fixture manifest simulates committed immutable object versions; this is not a production commit/recovery implementation.
This design harness does not perform runtime commits or live migration. Separate foundation/application tests and integration-validation.json record that evidence.
